firmware.note: v0.1.4 (built 2026-11-17): schedule v2 baked in as the embedded baseline (on the deployed panel the OTA schedule channel never landed - LittleFS is the suspect - so the corrected year now ships inside the firmware); LittleFS.begin now formats on fail so a dead filesystem self-heals. Check-in, Reset x3 force-update, USB service mode and the 03:00 wake anchor are unchanged from 0.1.3. The firmware channel reads only version + url; sha256/sizeBytes recorded for verification. httpUpdate fetches the APP image, not the merged flash image.
